title: Gem and Diamond Workers
description: Fabricate, finish, or evaluate the quality of gems and diamonds used in jewelry or industrial tools.

projection.title: Jewelers and precious stone and metal workers

tasks.text: Assign polish, symmetry, and clarity grades to stones, according to established grading systems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material quality often needs hands-on or visual inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of materials or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Identify and document stones' clarity characteristics, using plot diagrams.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Examine physical characteristics of gemstones or precious metals.
Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Estimate wholesale and retail value of gems, following pricing guides, market fluctuations, and other relevant economic factors.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Valuation aided; human owns final value judgment

dwas.name: Determine the value of goods or services.

tasks.text: Examine gems during processing to ensure accuracy of angles and positions of cuts or bores, using magnifying glasses, loupes, or shadowgraphs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gemstone grading requires hands-on sensory inspection

dwas.name: Examine physical characteristics of gemstones or precious metals.

tasks.text: Examine diamonds or gems to ascertain the shape, cut, and width of cut stones, or to select the cuts that will result in the biggest, best quality stones.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gemstone grading requires hands-on sensory inspection

dwas.name: Examine physical characteristics of gemstones or precious metals.

tasks.text: Examine gem surfaces and internal structures, using polariscopes, refractometers, microscopes, and other optical instruments, to differentiate between stones, to identify rare specimens, or to detect flaws, defects, or peculiarities affecting gem values.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gemstone grading requires hands-on sensory inspection

dwas.name: Examine physical characteristics of gemstones or precious metals.

tasks.text: Advise customers and others on the best use of gems to create attractive jewelry items.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Generates improvement options; human tailors and owns

dwas.name: Advise others on ways to improve processes or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Locate and mark drilling or cutting positions on stones or dies, using diamond chips and power hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.
Position hand tools.

tasks.text: Secure gems or diamonds in holders, chucks, dops, lapidary sticks, or blocks for cutting, polishing, grinding, drilling, or shaping.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Select shaping wheels for tasks, and mix and apply abrasives, bort, or polishing compounds.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mix substances to create chemical solutions.
Apply solutions to production equipment.

tasks.text: Measure sizes of stones' bore holes and cuts to ensure adherence to specifications, using precision measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Sort rough diamonds into categories based on shape, size, color, and quality.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical product sorting needs manipulation in warehouse

dwas.name: Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.

tasks.text: Place stones in clamps on polishing machines and polish facets of stones, using felt-covered or canvas-covered polishing wheels and polishing compounds such as tripoli and rouge.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual polishing of workpieces requires dexterity

dwas.name: Position raw materials on processing or production equipment.
Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.

tasks.text: Hold stones, gems, dies, or styluses against rotating plates, wheels, saws, or slitters to cut, shape, slit, grind, or polish them.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Maneuver workpieces in equipment during production.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Replace, true, and sharpen blades, drills, and plates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Secure stones in metal mountings, using solder.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Solder parts or workpieces.
Solder parts or connections between parts.

tasks.text: Immerse stones in prescribed chemical solutions to determine specific gravities and key properties of gemstones or substitutes.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gemstone grading requires hands-on sensory inspection

dwas.name: Examine physical characteristics of gemstones or precious metals.

tasks.text: Regrind drill points, and advance drill cutting points according to specifications for channel depths and shapes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Split gems along pre-marked lines to remove imperfections, using blades and jewelers' hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Shape glass or similar materials.
Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Position hand tools.

tasks.text: Lap girdles on rough diamonds, using diamond girdling lathes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machine tool operation is hands-on skilled work

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Fabricate products or components using machine tools.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Dismantle lapping, boring, cutting, polishing, and shaping equipment and machinery to clean and lubricate it.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Regulate the speed of revolutions and reciprocating actions of drilling mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling equipment operated by hand on site

dwas.name: Operate drilling equipment.

emerging_tasks.task: Buy and sell diamonds and diamond jewelry for clients.
